And I would say I was like, you know, maybe the 10th guy on campaign fighting. There were people already working out ahead of me. People with names like Biden and Kerry. They came in and I figured not only was I the least senior member of the entire Senate in terms of seniority. It wasn't until later in 1995 that we finally came together and said, let's do the big one, but let's do campaign finance.
